gaps.title: Validate circular leveled lists
gaps.acceptance: Expose native wbLeveledListCheckCircular as a structured read-only job, covering winning LVLI/LVLC/LVLN/LVSP records, cycle paths, progress and supported game gates.

gaps.title: Change, renumber and inject FormIDs
gaps.acceptance: Provide explicit single-ID change, arbitrary start/range renumbering and injection workflows with collision checks, dependent-reference updates, preservation options and dry-run mappings. Primitive setters are not semantic parity.

gaps.title: Replace referring FormIDs in single/batch workflows
gaps.acceptance: Accept explicit old/new mappings, scope and dependency additions; return complete changed-record results and partial failures. Verify CompareExchangeFormID/UpdateRefs ordering and avoid a GUI CSV picker.

gaps.title: Wrapper and spawn-rate copy modes
gaps.acceptance: Expose native CopyInto wrapper/spawn-rate transformations with explicit mode options and game applicability; verify output semantics independently of plain copies.

gaps.title: Copy idle animations
gaps.acceptance: Expose native idle-tree copy with ordered hierarchy/dependencies and target preflight; generic single-record copy is not sufficient proof.

gaps.title: Clean references to injected records
gaps.acceptance: Expose cleanup as a bounded dry-run/apply job with affected-record findings, native injection rules and dependency checks.

gaps.title: Create delta patches
gaps.acceptance: Accept explicit compared/source/target files and native delta options; report changed records, required masters and errors without modal file selection. Native operation immediately creates an .esu copy and reloads it; do not describe this as only an in-memory patch.

gaps.title: Create merged patches
gaps.acceptance: Expose native merge behavior and game gates with explicit inputs/target, dry run, per-record outcomes and reproducible merge fixtures.

gaps.title: Generate SEQ files
gaps.acceptance: Expose native SEQ generation with game gates, explicit bounded output path, overwrite policy, selected inputs and independently validated output. Preserve Skyrim GUI gate and eligible Start Game Enabled quest semantics.

gaps.title: Generate LOD
gaps.acceptance: Wrap the native LOD pipeline with supported games/worldspaces, explicit settings/output roots, progress, cancellation boundaries and fixture-based output verification. Preserve native rejection of Fallout 76/Starfield and include Split LOD Atlas output.

gaps.title: Build reachable information
gaps.acceptance: Expose native reachability analysis with roots/scope, structured findings and bounded progress; reference indexing alone is not the same operation.

gaps.title: Localize/delocalize, edit strings and select language
gaps.acceptance: Expose distinct conversion, string-table editing and language-selection contracts. Header localized flag alone is not conversion. Include string-table encoding, persistence and game support; headless LocalizationGetStringsFromFile is denied. Include child-editor string export and native Skyrim/FO4/FO76/Starfield gating.

gaps.title: Manage and use ModGroups
gaps.acceptance: Support create/edit/delete, CRC refresh, reload and enable/disable with explicit file scope and native conflict-group behavior; UI row hiding is separate.

gaps.title: Automatically set VWD from mesh resources
gaps.acceptance: Wrap native resource-based eligibility and override-target behavior; plain flag setters do not reproduce mesh discovery and filtering.

gaps.title: Generate BOSS/LOOT cleaning reports
gaps.acceptance: Provide native report formatting and structured counts/identities from validation/cleaning results; generic job findings are not the existing report export.

gaps.title: Apply only ITM removal or only UDR cleaning
gaps.acceptance: Offer distinct apply selectors/jobs preserving native eligibility and deleted-navmesh refusal. Current quick_clean combines operations. Depends on correctness fix #1.

gaps.title: Create/delete/copy file and group selections
gaps.acceptance: Define explicit file/group operations and multi-target scope beyond record-root commands; preflight ownership/protected targets and distinguish unload from physical removal.

gaps.title: Replace/copy/remove multiple rows across records
gaps.acceptance: Provide replacement vs append semantics, multiple-row selection and per-target outcomes with native schema preflight. Coordinate with batch work #17.

gaps.title: Load comparison files and compare arbitrary record selections
gaps.acceptance: Support comparison-only file loading and arbitrary record alignment without modal selection; report missing rows and scope separately from override conflict_status.

gaps.title: Cover native filter presets and remaining predicates
gaps.acceptance: Inventory native filter-dialog predicates against apply_filter, implement missing semantic predicates and distinguish query results from GUI filter state.

gaps.title: Add explicitly requested masters
gaps.acceptance: Provide a structured explicit-master-list operation with load-order/ownership preflight. files.add_required_masters infers dependencies and is not equivalent.

gaps.title: Expose reference-index rebuild
gaps.acceptance: Verify admitted BuildRef recipe or add a progress-aware command with scope, completeness and index revision reporting.

gaps.title: Expose persistent/VWD flag workflows
gaps.acceptance: Verify admitted setters and native REFR child-group migration; add structured flag operations with expected state if scripts cannot provide a reliable route.

gaps.title: Expose specialized diagnostics or declare unsupported
gaps.acceptance: Audit hidden/Test/Bandit Fix/race-LVLI actions per conditional build/game. Provide supported native diagnostics as explicit operations or document intentional exclusion.

gaps.title: Read/export messages and analyze logs
gaps.acceptance: Provide bounded cursor-based message access/export and log-analysis entrypoints with explicit input/output path policy. Script messages only cover that run, not the full session log.

gaps.title: Mark selected/native-filtered records modified
gaps.acceptance: Verify explicit MarkModifiedRecursive recipe and without-ONAM selection; report actual changed targets and preserve native game-specific rules.

gaps.title: Agent session options and game-link control
gaps.acceptance: Separate GUI appearance settings from semantic options/language/ModGroups/game-link configuration; expose supported semantic settings or intentional unsupported reasons.

gaps.title: Replace values/whole records through drag and column-copy workflows
gaps.acceptance: Expose native Assign replacement semantics separately from child append and generic record copy; cover full modal values and external compare workflow or explicitly exclude it. Verify schema compatibility, master preflight and resulting values.
